\chapter{Representative Reviews Submitted to the Labeling Model}
\label{app:semantic-examples}

This appendix reproduces, verbatim, the review samples shown to the labeling model (\texttt{claude-fable-5}) during the semantic labeling stage described in Section~\ref{sec:semantic-method}. For every non-outlier topic, the model received the topic's top c-TF-IDF keywords together with the twenty representative reviews boxed below, drawn from the classified corpus by fixed-seed random sampling. The texts appear exactly as submitted to the model---lowercased, stripped of punctuation, and normalized to ASCII by the preprocessing of Section~\ref{sec:semantic-method}---and are therefore reproduced without translation or redaction. Topics are ordered by document count, matching Tables~\ref{tab:semantic-topics-en} and~\ref{tab:semantic-topics-pt}. The reader is referred to the content advisory at the beginning of this work: the samples contain profanity, sexual language, and slurs reproduced as primary research data.

\section{English Corpus}
\label{app:semantic-examples-en}
